subsection.name: Automated Restricted Access
description: restrict access to media storage areas and log access attempts and access granted using organization defined automated mechanisms

subsection.name: Custodians
description: employ an identified custodian during transport of system media outside of controlled areas

subsection.name: Review, Approve, Track, Document, and Verify
description: review, approve, track, document, and verify media sanitization and disposal actions

subsection.name: Equipment Testing
description: test sanitization equipment and procedures organization defined frequency to ensure that the intended sanitization is being achieved

subsection.name: Nondestructive Techniques
description: apply nondestructive sanitization techniques to portable storage devices prior to connecting such devices to the system under the following circumstances: organization defined circumstances requiring sanitization of portable storage devices

subsection.name: Dual Authorization
description: enforce dual authorization for the sanitization of organization defined system media

subsection.name: Remote Purging or Wiping of Information
description: provide the capability to purge or wipe information from organization defined systems or system components remotely, or under organization defined conditions

subsection.name: Prohibit the Use of Sanitization Resistant Media
description: prohibit the use of santiziation resistant media in organizational systems

subsection.name: Equipment Testing
description: test downgrading equipment and procedures at organization defined frequency to ensure that downgradng actions are being achieved

subsection.name: Controlled Unclassified Information
description: downgrade system media containing controlled unclassified information prior to public release

subsection.name: Classified Information
description: downgrade system media containing classified infomraiton prior to release to individuals without required access authorizations
